title: Somewhat Positive Media Coverage Somewhat Unlikely to Impact Time (TIME) Share Price
text:
Now Is The Perfect Time For Apple Inc. (AAPL) To Buy Netflix, Inc. (NFLX) (msn.com) 
Several research analysts have recently issued reports on TIME shares. BidaskClub raised Time from a “strong sell” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Thursday, September 28th. Morgan Stanley decreased their target price on Time from $14.00 to $13.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a research report on Monday, October 23rd. Zacks Investment Research lowered Time from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Wednesday, October 11th. Evercore ISI initiated coverage on Time in a research report on Friday, November 17th. They issued an “outperform” rating and a $7.00 target price for the company. Finally, Citigroup lowered Time from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, December 4th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, five have assigned a hold rating, two have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company currently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $15.17. 
Time ( NYSE TIME ) opened at $18.45 on Tuesday. Time has a 52-week low of $9.90 and a 52-week high of $19.70. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.88, a quick ratio of 0.93 and a current ratio of 0.96. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,840.00, a P/E ratio of -922.50, a P/E/G ratio of 2.73 and a beta of 1.06. 
Time (NYSE:TIME) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 9th. The company reported $0.36 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $0.28 by $0.08. Time had a positive return on equity of 7.53% and a negative net margin of 0.10%. The company had revenue of $679.00 million during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $693.65 million. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $0.31 EPS. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was down 9.5% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts forecast that Time will post 1.06 earnings per share for the current year. 
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Friday, December 15th. Investors of record on Thursday, November 30th were given a dividend of $0.04 per share. This represents a $0.16 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 0.87%. The ex-dividend date was Wednesday, November 29th. Time’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently -800.00%. About Time 
Time Inc is a media and content company. The Company offers a portfolio of news and lifestyle brands across a range of interest areas. As of December 31, 2016, the Company’s brands included People, Time, Fortune, Sports Illustrated, InStyle, Real Simple, Southern Living, Entertainment Weekly, Food & Wine, Travel + Leisure and Essence, as well as approximately 50 titles in the United Kingdom.
